D: A TV dog who thinks his powers are real crosses the country to get home to his person, Penny.
P: Serve the snacks when Mittens teaches Bolt to beg at the RV park.
S: Tuna, mayo, celery and pickle on toasted English muffins

Toasted English muffins piled with creamy tuna, celery and pickle, smothered in melted cheddar and grilled until bubbling, cut into quarters. Mix 2 drained 185g tins of tuna with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 finely diced celery stick, 1 tbsp chopped pickles, a squeeze of lemon and pepper. Split and toast 4 English muffins. Spread the tuna over the 8 halves and top with 150g grated cheddar. Grill for 3 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Cut each half into quarters and serve warm.
Cheddar and cream cheese balls with chives, rolled in chopped walnuts
Cheddar, cream cheese and chives mixed, rolled into small balls and coated in finely chopped walnuts, chilled an hour and served with crackers.
Las Vegas jackpot chilli cheese popcorn
Bolt, Mittens and Rhino passing through Las Vegas

Popcorn tossed in melted butter with finely grated cheddar, parmesan, smoked paprika and a little chilli, hitting the jackpot in every handful. Heat 3 tbsp oil and 120g popcorn kernels in a big lidded pot over medium-high heat, shaking until the popping slows. Tip into a large bowl. Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1/2 tsp chilli powder and pour over. Blitz 50g grated cheddar and 30g parmesan to a fine powder and toss through with 1 tsp salt. Serve in paper cones.
M: Lime and garlic chargrilled chicken over coriander rice with black beans, charred corn, avocado, pickled onion and chipotle mayo. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and oil for 30 minutes. Cook 300g rice and stir through chopped coriander. Grill the chicken 5 minutes a side and slice. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Slice 1 red onion and soak in lime juice for 10 minutes. Build bowls with rice, warmed black beans, chicken, corn, avocado, onion and mayo mixed with chipotle.
Beef meatloaf glazed with tomato sauce, with potatoes
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash.
W: Buttery shortbread cut into bolt shapes
Shortbread dough of butter, flour and sugar rolled out, cut into lightning bolts, baked at 160C for 15 minutes and iced white once cool.
K: Chocolate ice cream, milk, malt powder and cocoa, blended thick

Chocolate ice cream, cold milk, malt and cocoa blended thick, with whipped cream and a crushed malt ball lightning bolt on top. Blend 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 600ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp cocoa for 30 seconds until thick. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Top each with whipped cream. Crush a handful of chocolate malt balls and scatter them over in a zigzag like Bolt's lightning bolt. Serve with wide straws.

s.note: Tuna, mayo, celery and pickle on toasted English muffins

s.note: Cheddar and cream cheese balls with chives, rolled in chopped walnuts
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and snipped chives until well combined. Roll into small balls, then coat in finely chopped walnuts. Chill for an hour until firm. Serve piled in a bowl with water crackers on the side for scooping.

m.note: Beef meatloaf glazed with tomato sauce, with potatoes
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion, a cup of breadcrumbs, an egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin, spread with tomato sauce and bake at 180C for an hour. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with butter. Serve thick slices of meatloaf on the mash.

w.note: Buttery shortbread cut into bolt shapes
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 350g flour to a soft dough. Roll out and cut into lightning bolt shapes. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes until pale golden. Cool on the tray, then ice with white icing made from icing sugar and water.
